title: Concept: Downloaded script piped into a shell in shell — review required
description: In shell, the output of curl or wget is piped into a shell. Nothing authenticates the bytes between the remote server and the interpreter, so the effective trust anchor is the network path at install time. A supply-chain compromise or an interception on that path becomes immediate code execution, often with the privileges of the installer.
applicability: shell build scripts, container images, and host provisioning steps.
risk: Remote code execution from an unverified download; HIGH severity.
